title: SGLang scheduler, RadixCache and HiCache state ownership
summary: Separate request state, physical KV slots, prefix-cache nodes and pending transfers when tuning chunked prefill, memory or speculation.

zh-CN.title: SGLang 调度、RadixCache 与 HiCache 状态所有权
zh-CN.summary: 调优分块预填充、内存或投机解码时，区分请求状态、物理 KV 槽、前缀节点和待完成传输。

conditions: Record prompt/output lengths, prefix reuse, arrivals, sampling, cache state and model state type.
Identify the selected plain RadixCache or UnifiedRadixCache and its allocator/component contracts.

recommendations: Trace admission, forward and finish/abort, then locate queueing, compute or host/storage-transfer delay.
Inspect declaration and compatibility/resolution hooks; include allocator/refcount cleanup when changing memory behavior.
validation_plan: Check hit/miss equivalence, partial prefixes, eviction, finish/abort cleanup and chunk boundaries.
For speculation verify draft/target compatibility, accepted-token accounting and rejected-state cleanup.
limitations: Full-attention assumptions do not automatically apply to SWA or Mamba components.
Fewer OOMs do not prove request-state correctness or improved service throughput.
This indexed abstract links to the complete English skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
